column1: # zxfer anti-rebloat policy (TAB-separated).
# Checked by tests/run_budget_check.sh (lint target: budget).
# Only sensitive-caller ratchets remain. The universal ceilings
# (module_lines, function_lines, function_decisions, test_lines,
# integration_fragment_lines, integration_runner_lines, setup_lines) were
# removed on 2026-09-01: they mechanically forced module and function
# splitting instead of preventing bloat (the source tree grew from 24.1k
# lines in 16 modules to 27.4k lines in 32 modules in three months while
# every ceiling stayed satisfied). Collapsing modules and inlining
# single-caller wrappers is allowed and encouraged.
# Caller rows count non-comment matches of a literal symbol across src/*.sh
# and zxfer, and may optionally restrict matches to an explicit
# comma-separated file list. They are ratchet-down-only: lowering a count is
# routine maintenance; raising one requires explicit review justification.
# Record kinds:
#   callers SYMBOL MAX [ALLOWED_FILES]
# Any other record kind fails closed.
# Refresh measured values with: tests/run_budget_check.sh --list
